career_ladder.note: The Indian Economic Service (IES) operates under the Department of Economic Affairs (Ministry of Finance), while the Indian Statistical Service (ISS) operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI). Both are premier Organized Central Group 'A' Specialist Services providing economic analysis, policy formulation, and statistical administration across central ministries and NITI Aayog.

exam_scheme.note: UPSC conducts the IES/ISS Examination in two parts: Part I Written Examination (1000 marks across 6 papers) and Part II Viva Voce / Personality Test (200 marks). Final merit is compiled out of 1200 marks aggregate. For IES, all 6 papers are conventional/subjective. For ISS, Statistics I & II are objective (80 questions each, 200 marks, 120 minutes, 1/3 negative marking), while Statistics III & IV are descriptive.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 10 entry basic pay (₹56,100) for Junior Time Scale officers with 58% DA. Officers posted in New Delhi ministries receive Category X HRA (27% or ₹15,147) and higher transport allowances.
official_perks: Central Government accommodation (General Pool Residential Accommodation - GPRA) / HRA (27%/18%/9%)
Official transport allowance (₹7,200 + 58% DA in Class X cities)
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) comprehensive family medical coverage
Annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined contribution pension under NPS
Deputation opportunities to multilateral economic institutions (IMF, World Bank, ADB) and regulatory commissions
